section_summary.extract_value: This section details the data analysis methods, specifically multilevel modeling, used to examine the association between gratitude and loneliness. It outlines the basic model equations and defines variables such as loneliness, gratitude, and day, which was included to control for reactance and habituation. The section also describes the centering and dummy-coding procedures for various control variables, including gender, marital status, employment status, age, depressive symptoms, life satisfaction, neuroticism, extraversion, and education, all within the context of a single study.
